edition.notes: Greek text edited by Schwartz with Mommsen's edition of Rufinus. This public-domain edition supplies an exact original-language control for 6.43.11, but it is an old critical edition and does not replace the later unchanged reprint's updated framing or fresh manuscript collation.
edition.publication: Leipzig: J. C. Hinrichs, 1908; Die griechischen christlichen Schriftsteller der ersten drei Jahrhunderte
edition.title: Eusebius Werke, volume 2, part 2: Die Kirchengeschichte, Bücher VI–X

passages.context: Printed page 618 was visually inspected. Eusebius quotes Cornelius's single combined total of fifty-two for exorcists, readers, and door-keepers; it supplies neither a separate exorcist count nor proof that the role was continuous or functionally identical with later major exorcism.
passages.notes: Old critical Greek control with Rufinus facing; not a fresh manuscript collation.
